Auditor_Jones: Hi team — auditor here. Need evidence that KMS/HSM access logs and key rotation records for production keys are retained for 24 months per SOC2. Please provide an export + sha256 manifest and a short sampling methodology. Also need control mapping for CC-3 (key lifecycle). Thanks.

ellie-security: Hi @Auditor_Jones — we'll pull this. Do you want a full export or a targeted sample? We keep CloudTrail/Audit logs for 24 months for KMS events; HSM operator logs are retained 36 months.

Auditor_Jones: Sample + repro steps first. Please target key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd1234 for period 2024-01-01..2024-12-31. Include CloudTrail file list, KMS rotation metadata, and a signed manifest. :mag_right:

sanjay-devops: I can run the export now, cc @ellie-security. Will produce S3 export with manifest and sha256. ETA ~6h.

sanjay-devops: command I ran for trace: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd1234 --start-time 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z > /tmp/kms-events.json
```
Sample event line: `{ "EventId": "abcd-1234", "EventName": "RotateKey", "EventTime": "2024-06-18T03:22:10Z" }`

ellie-security: Uploading evidence to secure share: s3://redwood-audit/2025-03/auditor_jones/sample_kms_abcd1234.zip
Manifest sha256: `3f5e7a9b2c1d4f6a8b0c9e1f2d3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1` — attached to the zip.

deploy-bot: Upload complete for s3://redwood-audit/2025-03/auditor_jones/sample_kms_abcd1234.zip — signed by ci-deploy-key-01

Auditor_Jones: Received. Can you include chain of custody (who exported, command history, and timestamp) and confirm logs were immutable? Also need proof that CloudTrail Log File Validation was enabled during the period.

ellie-security: Export run by sanjay-devops (sanjay@redwood.com) at 2025-03-12T11:30:12Z. Commands and partial stdout included in `/audit/exports/2025-03/kms_abcd1234/command_history.txt` inside the zip. CloudTrail config snippet (from account config):
```
{
  "IsOrganizationTrail": false,
  "EnableLogFileValidation": true
}
```

Auditor_Jones: Good. Also need KMS rotation status and key policy excerpt that shows rotation allowed by key admins.

sanjay-devops: rotation status check: `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id abcd1234` -> `KeyRotationEnabled: true`. Key policy excerpt saved as `policy.json` in the zip. Also ran `aws kms list-keys` to confirm key id.

Auditor_Jones: Thanks. Final ask: what's the timeline for the formal evidence package (zipped, signed, preserved in our evidence portal) and who is the POC for follow-ups?

ellie-security: Formal evidence package will be placed in the secure evidence portal and emailed to your registered mailbox by EOD 2025-03-12. POC: ellie-security@redwood.com. Tracking ticket: CS-7982. If you need anything else ping here and we'll escalate.

Auditor_Jones: :thumbsup: I'll review and confirm once downloaded.

sanjay-devops: noted — will hold logs and exports per retention policy. Closing when auditor confirms.
